import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Extract the relevant columns for analysis
education_expenditure = adjusted_savings_df.filter(regex='YR').values
gni_per_capita = gni_per_capita_df.filter(regex='YR').values
economic_output = exports_df.filter(regex='YR').values

# Calculate the correlation between education expenditure and per capita GDP
correlation_education_gni = np.corrcoef(education_expenditure, gni_per_capita)[0, 1]

# Calculate the correlation between per capita GDP and economic output
correlation_gni_output = np.corrcoef(gni_per_capita, economic_output)[0, 1]

correlation_education_gni, correlation_gni_output

# Check for missing values in the economic output dataset
economic_output_missing = exports_df.filter(regex='YR').isnull().sum().sum()
economic_output_missing

from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer

# Impute missing values in the economic output dataset
imputer = SimpleImputer(strategy='mean')
economic_output_imputed = imputer.fit_transform(economic_output)

# Recalculate the correlation between per capita GDP and economic output
correlation_gni_output_imputed = np.corrcoef(gni_per_capita, economic_output_imputed)[0, 1]
correlation_gni_output_imputed

# Check data types of the economic output dataset
economic_output_dtypes = exports_df.filter(regex='YR').dtypes
economic_output_dtypes

# Check for any anomalies in the economic output dataset
economic_output_anomalies = exports_df.filter(regex='YR').apply(lambda x: x.abs().max())
economic_output_anomalies

# Check the alignment of the datasets
adjusted_savings_df.head(), gni_per_capita_df.head(), exports_df.head()

from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression

# Prepare the data for regression
# Extract the data for the most recent year (2015) for simplicity
education_expenditure_2015 = adjusted_savings_df['2015 [YR2015]'].values.reshape(-1, 1)
gni_per_capita_2015 = gni_per_capita_df['2015 [YR2015]'].values
economic_output_2015 = exports_df['2015 [YR2015]'].values

# Perform linear regression to examine the relationship between education expenditure and per capita GDP
model_education_gni = LinearRegression()
model_education_gni.fit(education_expenditure_2015, gni_per_capita_2015)
coefficient_education_gni = model_education_gni.coef_[0]

# Perform linear regression to examine the relationship between per capita GDP and economic output
model_gni_output = LinearRegression()
model_gni_output.fit(gni_per_capita_2015.reshape(-1, 1), economic_output_2015)
coefficient_gni_output = model_gni_output.coef_[0]

coefficient_education_gni, coefficient_gni_output
